# orch8_queue_route (Resource)

A queue routing rule (`/routing-rules`): tasks for `handler_name` (optionally only those enqueued on `match_queue`) are redirected to `queue_override`. The API has no update, so every change replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send every `render_video` task to the `gpu` queue.
resource "orch8_queue_route" "render_on_gpu" {
  handler_name   = "render_video"
  queue_override = "gpu"
  priority       = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handler_name` (String) Handler whose tasks are routed.
- `queue_override` (String) Destination queue.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.
- `match_queue` (String) Only route tasks originally destined for this queue. Omit to match any queue.
- `priority` (Number) Rule precedence; higher wins. Defaults to 0.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Rule UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by routing rule UUID.
terraform import orch8_queue_route.render_on_gpu 0194d2e6-7f44-7e2a-9c3e-1a2b3c4d5e71
```
